note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: Athena
plugins.description: Use when producing a comprehensive account research brief with business context, Cursor usage signals, outbound triggers, break-in strategy, org mapping, and priority contacts — the canonical research pack, not a POV or BVA.

plugins.name: MEDDPICC Qualification
plugins.description: Use when scoring or coaching a Cursor opportunity against MEDDPICC (e.g. "Run MEDDPICC on {account}") — not for handoff briefs, customer stories, or relationship maps.

plugins.name: Relationship Map
plugins.description: Use when mapping who matters at an account — economic buyers, champions, technical influencers, risks, and coverage gaps — not for a full ownership handoff or MEDDPICC score.

plugins.name: Account POV Framework
plugins.description: Use when building a business-first account POV (business context, named tension, Cursor mapped to that tension, proof) for an exec conversation — not Athena research and not a BVA.

plugins.name: 30-Minute Follow-up Nudge
plugins.description: Use when a customer or prospect call just ended (or ended about 30 minutes ago) and {user} needs draft follow-up reminders of who owes what — not a weekly success plan, a handoff brief, or an in-call product answer.

plugins.name: Outbound Intelligence
plugins.description: Use when drafting cold outbound (email, LinkedIn, call) and you need proven patterns from #proj-outbound booked meetings and closed-won narratives — not a personal voice clone.

plugins.name: Territory PG Coverage
plugins.description: Use when generating a territory pipeline-generation coverage report for a named AE (outreach volume, meetings, contact depth, Potential ARR, untouched high-potential contacts, 30-day dark accounts) — book-level coverage, not a weekly success plan.

plugins.name: Stage-Gate Deal Validation
plugins.description: Use when validating open opportunities against Cursor's 5-stage enterprise sales process (PG → Discovery → Scope → Validation → Legal) with Met/Partial/Not Met proof plus named champion and EB — not a handoff brief, outbound draft, or single-account research dump.

plugins.name: Cold Outbound Patterns for Director+
plugins.description: Use when drafting Director/VP/C-level cold outbound at F1000 / 500+ SWE accounts from proven exec-email patterns — complementary to Outbound Intelligence (general cold outbound), not a personal voice clone.
